# R1: Data download, preparation and audit

{{logo_html}}

*Generated by `python -m recruit.run_r1` from `results/r1_data_report.json`. Do not edit the numbers
by hand.*

Data: StatsBomb Open Data (github.com/hudl/open-data), used under the StatsBomb Public Data User
Agreement; market values from transfermarkt-datasets (CC0-1.0, built by its maintainer from
Transfermarkt). StatsBomb logo from the StatsBomb Media Pack (statsbomb.com/media-pack), unchanged.
This page shows only counts and summaries, never event-level data.

## What this step does, in plain words

R1 gets the data ready. It downloads every match of the {{season_label}} season (StatsBomb season
{{season_id}}) for the four leagues, plus the Transfermarkt-derived player, club, appearance and
market-value tables. Each raw file is fingerprinted, so any later change to a file stops the pipeline.
The match files are then cut down, one match at a time, to the columns later steps need and saved as
compact parquet files, and everything is loaded into a DuckDB database with fixed column types.
Finally four checks ("gates") decide whether the data can support the project.

| Gate | What it asks | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Market values | Do league players have a valuation close to {{valuation_date}}? | **{{status.valuation}}** |
| 2. Pressures | Are pressure events recorded in all four leagues? | **{{status.pressure}}** |
| 3. Lineup times | Do lineup positions carry start and end times (needed for minutes played)? | **{{status.lineup}}** |
| 4. Size and memory | How big is the data and does preparing it fit an 8 GB laptop? | **{{status.resource}}** |

## Gate 1: market values around {{valuation_date}}

Who counts: every player with a Transfermarkt appearance in one of the four leagues during the
{{season_label}} season window. This list comes from the appearances table, not from the valuations, so the
check is not circular. A price may only use a valuation from on or before {{valuation_date}} (no
hindsight), so the gate is judged on the "6 months before" column. No valuation dated after
{{valuation_date}} is read or counted. The line to clear is {{gates.valuation.min_share_before|pct}} (config/audit.yaml), and
the departing player must have a usable valuation.

{{table:valuation_by_league}}

The departing player's valuation history in the 12 months up to the date (nothing later is
listed):

{{table:departing_history}}

The usable price for the departing player is the latest valuation on or before the date inside the
window: {{gates.valuation.departing_player.latest_before.market_value_eur}} EUR on
{{gates.valuation.departing_player.latest_before.date}}
({{gates.valuation.departing_player.latest_before.days_before}} days before).

## Gate 3: lineup positions with start and end times

{{gates.lineup.position_rows}} position spells in total; {{gates.lineup.with_from_time}} have a start
time ({{gates.lineup.share_from_time|pct}}; the line is {{gates.lineup.min_share_from_time|pct}}),
{{gates.lineup.with_to_time}} have an end time. {{gates.lineup.matches_with_both_teams}} of
{{gates.lineup.matches}} matches have position spells for both teams; each team used between
{{gates.lineup.min_players_per_team_match}} and {{gates.lineup.max_players_per_team_match}} players
per match. A spell with no end time means the player stayed on to the end:

{{table:open_ended}}
